name: oh-my-pi
description: OpenChamber extension for the omp-backed session: context window map and /goal status in a sidebar panel; home for omp-only views that have no OpenChamber equivalent. Context view vendored from MltStephane/openchamber-context; fed by the omp sidecar's /api/omp routes.

scripts.build: bunx openchamber-guest-bundle status/main.ts status/main.js && bunx openchamber-guest-bundle --node service/main.ts service/main.js
